description: Na₃TaS₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TaS₄ tetrahedra, edges with six NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.28 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TaS₄ tetrahedra, edges with six NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.30 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four TaS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TaS₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-59°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.23 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four TaS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TaS₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-59°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.01 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.21 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four TaS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TaS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-39°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.02 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.19 Å. There are two inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to four S atoms to form TaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with seven NaS₆ octahedra and edges with three NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-77°. There is one shorter (2.28 Å) and three longer (2.29 Å) Ta-S bond lengths. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to four S atoms to form TaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with seven NaS₆ octahedra and edges with two NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-75°. There are a spread of Ta-S bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.30 Å. There are eight inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ta atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ta atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ta atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Ta atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄Ta square pyramids. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Ta atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄Ta trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ta atom. In the seventh S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ta atom. In the eighth S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Ta atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₄Ta square pyramids.
